description: What two stored gate results say together, check by check.

label.description: The label the argument was, else the label the result was stored under; empty for none.

verdict.description: The first of regressed, still_failing, pass_was_already_failing and pass that a row carries; unverified when either result has no checks.

landable.description: True only for pass and pass_was_already_failing.

rows.description: One row per check, in the order of the --before result; empty when the verdict is unverified.

verdict.description: pass: passed before and after; pass_was_already_failing: did not pass before, passes now; regressed: passed before, does not now; still_failing: passes in neither. fail, error and timeout all count as not passing.
